description: Say what each bank or cash account **held before its first statement**, and the day that stands for everything before — **several in one call**. A document cannot read this off a file. The answer shows the check it buys: opening, plus what the statements moved since, has to equal the balance the last statement ended on, and the row says by how much when it does not. `clear: true` forgets one. A credit card has none. **Dry-runs by default**; the document is copied to a timestamped .bak first.

accounts.description: One entry per account. Up to 30 in a call.

account.description: The account, by id or by name.

amount.description: What it held, in the document's currency, e.g. 12500.50.

clear.description: True forgets the opening balance instead.

date.description: YYYY-MM-DD. The amount stands for everything before this day; statements start on it.

commit.description: Default false. False previews the batch; true writes it.

path.description: Absolute path to a .emd file on this machine.

name: set_opening_balances
title: Set accounts' opening balances
